scope: Set placement and selected UI constraints. No native rejection codes, activation/effect behavior or AI policy equivalence is claimed.

uiObservations.method: Manual review of retained frame-88000.png images; hashes and VRAM derivation are checked automatically, text is not OCR.
uiObservations.monsterSet: Krebons appears face-down in defense in zone 2 in m3-set-003/010; corroborated observed upper-16 raw state value 1 is not a universal position enum decoder.
uiObservations.allowanceUsed: Tin Goldfish offers only Show Details in m3-set-004/011 after setting Krebons; Summon and Set are unavailable.
uiObservations.allowancePreserved: Krebons in hand still offers Summon, Set and Show Details in m3-set-058/064 after setting Emergency Teleport.
uiObservations.occupiedMonster: Green Gadget was selected for Set; confirming occupied Krebons zone offers only Show Details and leaves the picker pending (024/027).
uiObservations.occupiedBackrow: Lightning Vortex was selected for Set; confirming the Emergency Teleport slot offers only Show Details and leaves the picker pending (061/066).
uiObservations.opponentSetSequence: Opponent sets a monster and two back-row cards; retained canonical IDs identify Chick, Scapegoat and Metalmorph. This is an aggregate turn sequence, not an isolated Trap-handler trace.

reproduction: Restore summon-baseline.ppst; choose Down, Circle (Set) in the Krebons menu. Inspect Tin Goldfish availability. Navigate to Emergency Teleport and choose Set. Restore and repeat.

From the turn-three attack anchor, enter Main2 and enable Manual placement through duel options (Circle applies). Choose Green Gadget Set. Retain m3-set-monster-picker.ppst; Left targets occupied zone 2, Circle opens Show Details. Restore and repeat.

Continue original play through turn seven to draw Lightning Vortex; the preparation includes activating Krebons and paying 800 LP. Retain m3-set-backrow-before.ppst at Emergency Teleport menu. Set it in zone 2, inspect Krebons availability, then attempt Lightning Vortex Set into occupied zone 2. Restore and repeat.

Place Green Gadget into free zone 3 from its picker; end turn three. Stop in opponent turn-four Standby after drawing Chick and retain m3-set-opponent-before.ppst. Resume to player turn-five Draw before drawing. Restore and repeat.
limitations: No direct RAM setup writes were used for these set scenarios. Earlier effects in the turn-seven preparation remain outside the comparison contract.
UI constraints do not expose PSP error codes or certify internal native command-handler rejection behavior. C# errors are implementation-specific.
For the turn-seven back-row cases C# compares back-row IDs and action deltas, not absolute LP, turn, hand/deck contents, unrelated monsters or prior effects.
Other full projections compare LP/counts/IDs, actor, turn and phase, not entire hidden state, RNG, timing, full deck order or other native flags.
Position/face-down observations use manual frame review plus retained raw state; an independent generic native position decoder is not established.
Trap placement is observed within the opponent three-card set sequence. Trap-specific occupied-zone selection is not separately captured.
Scapegoat, Metalmorph and other effect-bearing cards have setting-only explicit C# rules; their activations, effects, AI decisions and targeting are not implemented by these tests.
These references do not complete all M3 scenarios or establish any native byte match.
